==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
An alien female presence by the name of Remia approaches me. Her body seems to be made of coiled together white and silver strands of metal thread. She has long blonde hair and glowing blue eyes.

She sends me to another planet to complete a quest. The planet resembles a combination of Mars and the Moon. I am not entirely sure what it is called.

I travel through a forest to go see a psychic. I have to quiet my mind to avoid being attacked by telepathic bees. When I make it to the psychic, I realize that the real mission was to learn how to bolster my psychic defenses against telepaths.
